editorial.blurb: Wentworth Seafood House delivers consistently excellent Cantonese seafood with generous portions, friendly service, and prices that feel like a steal.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the fish and request the two-way preparation ($10 extra) to get both a silken tofu soup and steamed fillet — reviewers rave about the soup especially. Come with a group since portions are huge.
signatureDishes: Giant clams with garlic and vermicelli noodles
